reel.title: Trump, Xi and Putin pledged more fuel | What their four-point declaration says
reel.hook: TRUMP, XI AND PUTIN PLEDGED [MORE FUEL]
reel.topic: Outcome of the first Trump-Xi-Putin three-way meeting (Shenzhen, Thursday 19 Nov, about 80 minutes, on the APEC sidelines): a four-point 'Declaration towards Peace' published by Xinhua and the Kremlin, later by the White House. Points: reform the UN; 'plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products' and 'stable energy flows'; immunities of state officials and the ICC 'must not abuse' its jurisdiction; 'a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought' plus a dialogue on nuclear risks. No volumes, dates or targets (Rystad Energy via Rigzone; BeInCrypto; the text itself). The text does not mention Ukraine or Iran (RFE/RL, Euronews, the text). Leaders called it historic (Trump 'making history', Xi 'constructive' via China's foreign ministry, Putin 'very useful'); Germany's Merz called it a 'photo op' (RFE/RL), France's foreign minister Barrot said the three 'fundamentally disagree on everything' (Euronews). Next: G20 in Miami in December, Putin invited (Al Jazeera); the nuclear-risk dialogue has no date.

'European gasoil, a diesel benchmark' : the words 'a diesel benchmark' are my gloss of 'gasoil'; Rigzone's text says only 'European gasoil prices fell 1.5 percent on the news'.
'About 80 minutes' is Euronews ('an hour and 20 minutes'); Al Jazeera says 'more than one-hour-long'.

The four points are listed in the order of the Xinhua text as The National printed it (UN, energy, ICC, nuclear), without numbers; RFE/RL lists them in another order. TASS describes the document as a preamble and four paragraphs.

Translations differ slightly by outlet: Xi's remark is 'positive, constructive, and very productive' (RFE/RL, via spokesperson Mao Ning) or 'positive, constructive and fruitful' (Euronews, via state media); the Reel quotes only 'constructive'. The ICC line is 'must not abuse their jurisdiction' (The National) or 'abuse their positions' (Al Jazeera); the Reel quotes only 'abuse'.
Putin and the G20: Al Jazeera (19 Nov) says Trump has invited him to Miami next month; nothing read today says whether he will attend, and the Reel does not say so.
